cartographer.inference: The existing shared-inquiry proposal remains a useful, explicitly partial comparison. Statistical opinion mapping can reveal patterns of agreement, but is not equivalent to FN-25's provenance-bearing artifacts, alternatives, and unresolved questions. A duplicate proposal would not deepen this distinction.
cartographer.uncertainty: Public product descriptions do not establish real-world efficacy or equivalence with Cyberdelic OS. Moderation, identity, data governance, and losses in clustered representations remain open. This check does not revalidate the original paper, repository license, or every historical external claim.
cartographer.attribution: Public primary project documentation and exact public Cyberdelic OS publications only. No endorsement or collaboration is implied.
